[[File:MM9_Type-12A_Anti-Personnel_Rocket_EGWT.png|thumb|right|250px|A Type-12A Anti-Personnel Rocket with a Rotating Balance Stabilizer situated behind the warhead]]
A '''Rotating Balance Stabilizer''' was a component of the [[Type-12A Anti-Personnel Rocket]]. It was mounted behind the explosive [[Warhead/Legends|warhead]], flaring out before tapering back into their [[Missile/Legends|missile's]] fuselage. It was designed to assist the flight of the projectile by balancing and stabilizing the missile as it rotated.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
